💡 Quick summary

The Marine Institute of Ireland publishes weekly bulletins tracking the development of toxic and harmful phytoplankton blooms in Irish waters, providing critical data for shellfish safety, aquaculture management, and marine ecosystem monitoring with bulletins available as downloadable PDFs dating back to 2024.

📌 Key takeaways

  • The Weekly HAB Bulletin provides ongoing monitoring of harmful algal blooms (HABs) that can produce toxins affecting shellfish and marine ecosystems.
  • The latest available bulletin is Week 21 of 2026, with continuous weekly coverage maintained throughout 2024-2026.
  • Bulletins are published as downloadable PDFs (approximately 2.7 MB each), freely accessible to researchers, aquaculture operators, and the public.
  • The service is part of the Marine Institute's broader seafood safety and marine environment monitoring mandate, linked to the HABs Shellfish Monitoring Programme.
  • The monitoring program supports Ireland's aquaculture industry by enabling early warning and risk-based management of shellfish harvesting areas.
